messages:
Jamie (release lead): Heads-up — doing a final changelog sweep before cutoff at 5pm PT. If you touched release notes for your PRs, please confirm shape + author and fix any lint failures. :eyes:
Alex R.: On it. Quick Q — do we prefer 'component: area' tags or the short component parentheses? e.g., 
- runtime (serving): improved batching 
vs
- runtime: improved batching (serving)
Jamie (release lead): Prefer the `component: short-tag` pattern so the release UI can auto-group. So: `runtime: improved batching (serving)` please.
Morgan L.: can do. Also pinging @Alex R. — I saw one entry that was sentences not bullets, will convert.
Priya S.: small one — added a docs change that mentions a template update. Where should author attribution go? inside the bullet or after?
Alex R.: put author in parentheses at end of bullet like `(Authored by Priya S.)`. Keeps list compact.
release-bot: Checklist: https://redwood-inference.internal/release/checklist · CHANGES.md linter: https://ci.internal/builds/3456 (fails: 1 file)
sre-bot: FYI deploy window for prod bump is tomorrow 10:00 UTC, nothing blocking yet.
Alex R.: here's an example snippet I'll paste so people can copy-paste the shape:
```
- runtime: reduce per-token memory overhead when KV cache disabled (Authored by Alex R.)
- api: fix batch retry to respect 429 backoff (Authored by Morgan L.)
- docs: add changelog template and examples (Authored by Priya S.)
```
Morgan L.: I'll update #789 with the converted bullets and push a small followup commit. tagging @jamie when done.
Priya S.: updated my PR, added `(Authored by Priya S.)` to the bullet. Linter still flags line > 120, will wrap.
Alex R.: wrapped lines, fixed tags. Pushed. :shipit:
Jamie (release lead): Thanks — final cutoff remains 5pm PT. If CI still fails after that we'll hold the entry and merge post-release. Please add short reviewer note if you expect post-cutoff changes.
Morgan L.: ack, I'll add a reviewer note on the PR.
Jamie (release lead): Great. If no objections I'll run the changelog concat and lint fix job at 4:50pm PT. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alex R.: no objections from me.
release-bot: Reminder scheduled for 16:30 PT.
Jamie (release lead): Perfect. Thanks team — quick turnaround as always.
